integrity: Computational conclusions are derived from two independent exact smoothness classifiers. A four-chart Groebner unit-ideal test checks smoothness and base transversality over the algebraic closure; a separate F16 classifier reproduces the 144 smooth forms and 804 pencils. Complete orbit and base-cycle calculations have reproducible code and output.
scientific_limitations: This finite exact classification concerns smooth rational members of bidegree-(2,2) pencils on the split quadric over the two-element field only; it does not classify abstract genus-one curves or extension-field parameter pencils. Historic equivalent finite-geometry tables may exist. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Thirteen orbit classes and five Frobenius base spectra of smooth \((2,2)\) pencils over \(\mathbf F_2\)
